basis: The grid content box is 40x100px. The explicit first row is 10px. Each percentage fit-content limit resolves against the definite 100px block-size. Track-list order starts at the first implicit row and repeats after its final entry.
independentCalculation: For the 20% scenes, fit-content caps the first implicit row at 20px; fixed nested payloads provide min-content/max-content contributions of 34px, 10px, and 6px. Before content distribution both patterns total 80px including the explicit row. With align-content:stretch, the single auto max-sizing track receives the remaining 20px; the min-content track keeps its contribution. Reordering auto and min-content moves the 20px stretch to the other row while preserving item contributions. In the 120% control, the fourth implicit row repeats fit-content; its 50px contribution has a growth limit above the remaining 40px, so it uses 40px. The nested payload remains visible and extends 10px below the 100px grid border.
